plan.title: Terms and Conditions absent on saved eRFX draft

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the test tenant.
Apply the setting whose effect on the draft's Terms & Conditions control is being tested.
Match the case's required tenant configuration.
Give the draft the mandatory title needed to save it.
Create an eRFX draft with the RFQ stage used by the case.
Apply a pricing template so the draft has a valid configured stage.
Add the minimum line item required for a usable saved draft.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Persist the eRFX event as an unpublished draft.
Confirm the draft save did not produce an application error.
Navigate to the Events list to reopen the saved draft.
Confirm the events list rendered before selecting Drafts.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Open the draft created by this plan.
Assert the subject of the case: Terms & Conditions is not offered on the saved draft.
